transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've not been sleeping well at all, that's the main thing. It's been going on for a while now.
When did you first notice it?
Hard to say exactly — it came on a while back. Around the time I stopped working, I suppose.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
If I've had a good long walk during the day it's better. But if I sit up late watching telly it's worse.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
I just can't stay asleep. I drop off fine, but then I'm wide awake in the early hours and can't get back down again.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's not really a pain anywhere, it's just... not sleeping. There's nowhere it spreads to.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
Not too bad really... well, it's hard to put a number on it. It's a nuisance more than anything.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's most nights, I'd say. It comes and goes a bit but it's pretty much the same most of the time.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
My mood's been a bit low at times, I suppose, since I retired. Nothing serious like that, but I've not felt quite myself.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yeah, I've got high blood pressure, and I've got trouble with an enlarged prostate. I'm on tablets for both.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?

Just some tablets for my blood pressure and one for the prostate. Nothing else really.

Actually — I have been taking some sleeping tablets from the chemist too, most nights lately.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I've never had a reaction to anything like that.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I've been too tired to get down to my allotment, and I keep nodding off in the chair in the afternoon. That's not like me.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I'd just like to be given some proper sleeping tablets, to be honest. That's what I'm hoping for.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
